core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sabr is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Patience, endurance”.

core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabr corresponds to the Arabic form صَبْر (Arabic root ص ب ر (ṣ-b-r); صَبْر (Ṣabr)). Its core sense is sabr; patience, endurance. persian.name: صبر
